stem: A fully immunised 4-year-old with four documented tetanus-containing vaccines presents with a dirty wound and is otherwise on schedule. What tetanus prophylaxis is required?

options.text: No tetanus-specific prophylaxis beyond wound care
Restart the full tetanus vaccine course

explanation: A child with a complete age-appropriate tetanus vaccination history does not need extra tetanus vaccine or immunoglobulin for a dirty wound unless the interval criteria for a booster are met. Good wound care remains required.
